scope: Frozen control regression, 24x2 business/security matrix, agent-driven continuation, and A/B/C comparison for the imported package: A=current ClawX host surface, B=pinned source, C=host-integrated module.

matrix.migratedTaskNote: mig-21, mig-24 and mig-01 credits are pinned-source history readings; no pass is manufactured here.

frozenConsumer.note: the same frozen control consumer (scripts/check-toolbox-consumer.mjs from the pinned source) run against the packed B and C packages; the documented-SDK program expectation is read from a frozen control copy outside the candidate

agentDrivenContinuation.result: synthetic auth/challenge fixture: account sign-in, session expiry pauses automation, an out-of-band operator (holding a secret the agent surface never sees) completes the step, the agent re-observes and submits exactly once; token rotation/refusal/replay negative cases pass
agentDrivenContinuation.note: does not impersonate a human, does not solve a real CAPTCHA, does not rewrite archived humanSteps; historical mig-22 not_run remains historical

electronE2e.evidence: tests/e2e/agent-browser-workbench.spec.ts passes (13-19s) when the Playwright temp root is a writable in-repo path (CLAWX_E2E_RUN_ROOT / TEMP under D:\ClawX\.tmp\e2e-root) and ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1. An earlier run failed at fixtures/electron.ts firstWindow because the temp root was D:\tmp, where the app hit an intermittent EPERM atomic-write on app-version-state.json.
electronE2e.correction: The earlier 'environment_blocked' note in this file was wrong; it was a temp-root permission issue, not a host limiter.

validationBoundary: Development-path evidence: frozen control consumer and 24-task matrix run against the packed module and the pinned source, plus the module-local and host-local regression suites. It does not prove packaged distribution, cross-platform execution, or product cutover.

denominators.note: Four denominators are counted separately and never aggregated into a single pass rate.
